name: page-size
title: Orders page shows 50 rows instead of 10
oneLiner: The orders page now lists 50 orders per page instead of 10, using pageOfOrders.

hunks.diff:
- export const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
+ export const PAGE_SIZE = 50;
hunks.explain: Each page now lists 50 orders instead of 10.

plainTerms:
Someone opens the orders page. Before, they saw ten orders and had to press next again and again.

Now they see fifty orders at once. The next button appears only when more orders are waiting.

lenses.creational: Nothing new is constructed. PAGE_SIZE is a constant read by both functions; only its value changed.
lenses.structural: handleListOrders asks pageOfOrders for the rows. Both read PAGE_SIZE, so the page size lives in one place.
lenses.behavioral: With 120 orders, page 0 returns 50 rows and hasMore is true; page 2 returns the last 20 and hasMore is false.

pseudocode.title: List one page of orders
pseudocode.code:
when a list request arrives:
  rows = orders from page * 50, up to 50 rows
  hasMore = (page + 1) * 50 < total orders
  reply with rows and hasMore

nodes.label: handleListOrders
nodes.desc: Answers the list-orders request for one page.

nodes.label: pageOfOrders
nodes.desc: Cuts one page out of the full list of orders.

nodes.label: PAGE_SIZE
nodes.desc: How many orders one page holds: 10 before, 50 now.

steps.note: A list request arrives for a page number
The handler asks for that page's rows
The handler compares (page + 1) * 50 with the total to set hasMore
